summary: The transient GitHub retry implementation and focused PR monitor regression tests are present for status fetch, pre-merge recheck, merge attempts, notification posting, fix-cycle settle polling, and thread resolution, and ruff, mypy, the narrow transient test selection, and the full unit suite pass.
